# Original LEZAC.EXE level-1 monster kill capture: the corpse sprite
# of a RIGHT-facing kind-1 walker. Captured in-container under DOSBox
# via tick-locked /proc/mem sampling (frame counter DS:0x78C2 polled;
# one 64 KiB DS pread per tick; visual table DS:0xC21E stride 8, count
# DS:0xC496). The walker was killed with a small bomb placed ahead of
# it; the player was moved clear so only the walker died.
#
# Companion to monster_sprite_consumption_original_level1.txt, which
# captured a LEFT-facing walker (pre_sprite_runs=44x4,43x2) dying to
# sprite 47. Together the two fix the corpse sprite as a facing pair.
#
# Visual record bytes 4,5 are the sprite's width,height; bytes 6,7 are
# the sprite pointer. Within the 17x10 walker band the pointer advances
# 170 bytes per frame, so index = (pointer - 3698) / 170.
